evidence.quote: The available test sheet reports a hearing average of 32 dB while both hearing aids were worn, but it does not supply an unaided better-ear result or a complete frequency list; the driver is able to follow a quiet face-to-face exchange yet repeatedly misses radio instructions beside an idling engine, and the nurse documents possible hearing loss without treating the aided number as an unaided threshold or assuming that all commercial assessment requirements were tested.
